card.text: GJ 367 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Gliese 367 b"
sources.quote: Gliese 367 b, formally named Tahay, is a sub-Earth exoplanet orbiting the red dwarf star Gliese 367, 30.7 light-years from Earth in the constellation of Vela.

introduction.text: It is one of 3 planets known around GJ 367. Its orbit and size follow Lee et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Gliese 367 b"
sources.quote: The exoplanet takes just 7.7 hours to orbit its star, one of the shortest orbits of any planet.
